description_en: Updates an environment and triggers an automatic deployment when its template parameters change
description_zh: 修改环境，并在模板参数变化时自动部署该环境
kebab_example: aliyun devs update-environment --name demo-env --project-name demo-project --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateEnvironment

parameters.help_en: The name of the environment. It must be unique within the project and cannot be changed
parameters.help_zh: 环境名称，项目下唯一，不可修改
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The type of the resource. This property is read-only
parameters.name: kind

parameters.help_en: The ID of the owning Alibaba Cloud account. This property is read-only
parameters.help_zh: 当前阿里云主账号的ID，只读
parameters.name: uid

parameters.help_en: The server-side timestamp indicating when the resource was created. This property is read-only
parameters.help_zh: 创建此对象时服务器的时间，只读
parameters.name: created_time

fields.help_en: The environment type. Valid values are testing, staging, and production
fields.help_zh: 环境类型，只能在testing、staging、production中选择
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the environment role
fields.name: role_arn

fields.help_en: The staged configs for the environment, which can be applied by a deployment
fields.help_zh: 环境下保存的配置，可以通过部署达到该配置状态
fields.name: staged_configs

parameters.help_en: The key-value labels for the environment
parameters.name: labels

fields.help_en: Service instances created by deploying project services using the current environment's configuration
fields.help_zh: 项目下的服务使用当前环境中的配置进行部署后产生的服务实例
fields.name: services_instances

fields.help_en: The name of the deployment plan for the most recent deployment. Each environment deployment generates a deployment plan that may include one or more services
fields.help_zh: 最近一次部署计划的名称。每次环境部署都会产生一个部署计划，涉及若干个服务的部署
fields.name: latest_environment_deployment_name

fields.help_en: A list of service names that have pending changes
fields.help_zh: 存在未部署的变更的服务名称列表
fields.name: services_with_pending_changes

fields.help_en: The most recent generation of the resource observed by the system
fields.help_zh: 系统最新观测到的资源generation
fields.name: observed_generation

fields.help_en: The timestamp when the status was last observed
fields.help_zh: 资源最近的一次状态更新时间
fields.name: observed_time

parameters.help_en: The current status of the environment
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The name of the project that contains the environment. This property is read-only
parameters.help_zh: 环境所属的项目名称，只读
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: A system-generated, auto-incrementing number representing the configuration generation. This property is read-only and increments each time the `spec` is updated
parameters.help_zh: 当前配置的自增的序列号，由系统填充，只读。当spec更新时递增
parameters.name: generation

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The environment object. This operation updates only the specified writable fields. Unspecified fields remain unchanged
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 环境实体。您指定的可写字段将被更新，未指定的字段将保持不变
v1_body_parameters.name: body

v1_parameters.help_en: The environment object. This operation updates only the specified writable fields. Unspecified fields remain unchanged
v1_parameters.help_zh: 环境实体。您指定的可写字段将被更新，未指定的字段将保持不变
v1_parameters.name: body
